## 元の定義 {#raw-definition}

```text
# Ordered flight control transaction on one DDS topic and one UDP datagram.
# Execution order: renew, flight, engines (array order), separation, release.
# Use one increasing sequence and do not mix batch and individual commands
# within a lease. Acquisition uses ControlAuthorityCommand.
# release_lease allows cutoff and release in one transaction; no separation/renew.
std_msgs/Header header
# Optional legacy guard/producer stream fields; leave empty for active_vessel.
string vessel_id
string controller_id
string lease_id
uint64 sequence
bool release_lease
bool renew_lease
float64 lease_duration_sec
bool suppress_sas
bool has_flight
FlightControlCommand flight
EngineCommand[<=16] engines
bool has_separation
SeparationCommand separation
```
